Package org.applecommander.archive.binaryii

package org.applecommander.archive.binaryii

Binary II archive format support.

Binary II is a binary archive format for Apple II files, identified by ProDOS file type $E0 (224) and auxiliary type $8000. It was designed as a successor to the earlier Binary format, preserving ProDOS file metadata (type, subtype, access code, dates) while also supporting files from other operating systems such as DOS 3.3, Apple Pascal, Macintosh MFS/HFS, and MS-DOS.

Each file in a Binary II archive is stored as a 128-byte header block followed by the file's data padded to 128-byte boundaries. The header begins with identification bytes 0x0A 0x47 0x4C at offset 0 and 0x02 at offset 18. The header encodes both ProDOS 8 and GS/OS metadata, including file names (Pascal and native), sizes, creation and modification timestamps, and data flags indicating compression, encryption, or sparse content.

Common file extensions are .bny, .bqy, and .bxy.

This package provides a FileStore implementation that parses Binary II archives and exposes their contents through the standard AppleCommander file store API, enabling browsing and extraction of archived files with full metadata.
